constraints: The command has no effect if the view is already at the requested scroll limit (e.g. rangeObj is already the topmost/leftmost cell and the view is repositioned to top/left, or the view's scroll limits are otherwise already reached).

params.name: rangeObj
params.description: Range of cells to bring into view

params.name: vPos
params.description: Vertical view position of cell or row

sentinelValues.meaning: Vertical alignment to the bottom of the cell or row.
Alignment to the vertical center (cell/row limit).
Alignment to the closest vertical limit (top, center, bottom).
Vertical alignment to the top of the cell or row.

params.name: hPos
params.description: Horizontal view position of cell or row

sentinelValues.meaning: Alignment to the horizontal center (cell/column limit).
Horizontal alignment to the left of the cell or column.
Alignment to the closest horizontal limit (left, center, right).
Horizontal alignment to the right of the cell or column.
